rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts must exist before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs must remain contiguous.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Example IDs must remain unique and prior repairs preserved.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_GATE: Parcel-specific contributing survey identity requires EA metadata-index matching.
rule_descriptions.EA_TIME_OF_YEAR_GATE: Catalogue time-of-year metadata is lineage context, not parcel terrain.
rule_descriptions.EA_SPATIOTEMPORAL_INDEX_GATE: Spatial/temporal index metadata is not elevation data.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM10M_DERIVED_GATE: 10m DTM is bilinear-resampled from 2m and is secondary only.
rule_descriptions.EA_GROUND_TRUTH_ROLE: Ground-truth surveys are independent survey QC, not parcel raster samples.
rule_descriptions.EA_RMSE_ROLE: EA +/-15cm RMSE is survey/data accuracy, not a parcel confidence interval.
rule_descriptions.EA_POINT_DENSITY_ROLE: Point-cloud density is not raster resolution.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM_DSM_ROLE: DSM/first-return surface products are excluded from bare-earth primary result.
rule_descriptions.EA_COMPOSITE_RESAMPLING: Composite bilinear resampling must be explicit provenance.
rule_descriptions.EA_SURVEY_DATE_ROLE: Publication/revision dates must not substitute for acquisition dates.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_OS_MAP_ROLE: OS topographic mapping does not represent property boundaries.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_PLAN_IDENTIFICATION: Application-plan precision is registration evidence, not terrain accuracy.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_GENERAL_BOUNDARY: General boundary has no standard numeric tolerance to legal boundary.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_DETERMINED_BOUNDARY: Exact boundary claims require determined-boundary evidence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_TITLE_PLAN_ROLE: Title plan must be read with register/filed documents and shows general extent.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_GUIDE_VERSION: Guide collection currentness is authority routing only.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_HORIZONTAL_TOLERANCE: Determined-boundary plan tolerances are horizontal/legal, not LiDAR vertical RMSE.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_CELL_MEAN: Terrain5 5m values are cell means and secondary only.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_PIXEL_CENTER: ASCII grid sample positioning uses pixel-centre convention.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_TIN: Grid/contour products are interpolated from a source TIN.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_METADATA: Per-tile metadata is lineage/version context, not parcel acquisition proof.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_DATUM: Horizontal CRS and vertical datum must remain distinct.
rule_descriptions.OGC_GEOTIFF_RASTER_TYPE: PixelIsArea and PixelIsPoint have different reference conventions.
rule_descriptions.OGC_GEOTIFF_TRANSFORM: Tiepoint/pixel-scale/transformation tags georeference pixels but do not certify terrain accuracy.
rule_descriptions.OGC_CIS_DOMAIN_RANGE: Coverage domain and range semantics must remain consistent.
rule_descriptions.OGC_REFERENCEABLE_GRID: Referenceable grids must not be assumed equivalent to rectified regular grids.
rule_descriptions.OGC_WCS_INTERPOLATION: Interpolation must be explicit where applied.
rule_descriptions.OGC_WCS_CRS: Output CRS transformation is processing, not native-grid evidence.
rule_descriptions.OGC_WCS_RANGE: Range subsetting selects components and is distinct from spatial resampling.
rule_descriptions.OGC_COG_ROLE: Cloud optimization affects access/tiling, not source accuracy.
rule_descriptions.PIXEL_SELECTION_ROLE: Canonical pixel inclusion rule must remain explicit and reproducible.
rule_descriptions.ABSENCE_NOT_ZERO: No-data/unknown lineage must never be converted to zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Measured 1m/2m parcel values remain unchanged during QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is repository workflow confidence, not a universal statistical guarantee.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows stay zero before recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while receipts are missing.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo overlay is not live Chromium acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Do not rewrite shared main manifest under concurrent writers.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_PROMOTION_GATE: Only official scoped evidence is promoted.
rule_descriptions.FORMAT_NOT_ACCURACY: Encoding/container choice does not increase source accuracy.
rule_descriptions.PROCESSING_NOT_NATIVE: Derived processing output must not be called native.
